title: Shared Items
statement: Implement `solve(left, right)`. Return the strings that appear in both lists, sorted ascending, each string once. Multiplicity does not matter.
hints: Build a set from one side and intersect with the other.
Sort the result so the order is deterministic.
An empty side yields an empty list.

approaches.name: Direct
approaches.explanation: Membership in a set is expected constant time, so the intersection is linear in the two lengths.

editorial: Membership in a set is expected constant time, so the intersection is linear in the two lengths. Returning a set is not JSON-friendly and is unordered. A sorted list is the stable result the tests check.
reference_solution:
def solve(left, right):
    return sorted(set(left) & set(right))
